7.2.20.3.11 Trigger: T_TRCV_NORMAL_INDICATED
[SWS_CanSM_00448] ⌈If CanSM module has got the CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_NORMAL mode indication (ref. to
[SWS_CanSM_00399]) for the configured CAN Transceiver of the CAN network (ref. to [ECUC_CanSM_00137]) after the respective request (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00446]), this shall trigger the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_DeinitPnSupported of the CAN network with T_TRCV_NORMAL_INDICATED.⌋(SRS_Can_01142, SRS_Can_01145)
